company.name: 1Password
company.shortDescription: 1Password operates as a password manager for documents, credit card information, and addresses.
company.description:
1Password is a secure password manager that provides businesses and families with a safe way to share passwords, credit cards, and documents. It keeps important information secure with AES 256-bit encryption. They allow users to keep the information easily organized with convenient categories and tags and find what they need with a customizable search.

Founded in 2005, 1Password remembers and fills web forms with passwords, credit card information, and addresses—with a single click. It is focused on making security convenient and keeping customers happy. It is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario in Canada.
